params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$branch='integration/complete-mod-workflows-final-20260929'
$wt=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'agent-worktrees\complete-workflows-final-20260929'
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune
$base=(git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main).Trim()
if(Test-Path $wt){ git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null | Out-Null; if(Test-Path $wt){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $wt}}
git -C $repo branch -D $branch 2>$null | Out-Null
git -C $repo worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/main | Out-Null
Push-Location $wt
try {
  git merge --no-commit --no-ff origin/codex/complete-mod-workflows
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ Write-Output 'EXPECTED_CONFLICTS' }

  git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree -- .gitattributes .github/workflows/windows-workflows.yml .gitignore .verification AGENTS.md CHANGELOG.md README.md _AGENT_CONTEXT

  git checkout --ours -- src/MhwModManager.App/MainWindow.xaml
  $xaml='src/MhwModManager.App/MainWindow.xaml'
  $x=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($xaml)
  if($x -notmatch 'OpenWorkflowsCommand'){
    $anchor='Content="Export collection recipe"'
    $i=$x.IndexOf($anchor,[StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if($i -lt 0){throw 'WORKFLOW_BUTTON_ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND'}
    $e=$x.IndexOf([char]10,$i); if($e -lt 0){$e=$x.Length-1}
    $button='                                    <Button Margin="0,0,0,7" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Content="Loadouts, rules & diagnostics" Command="{Binding OpenWorkflowsCommand}"/>'+[Environment]::NewLine
    $x=$x.Insert($e+1,$button)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($xaml,$x,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  }
  git add -- $xaml

  git checkout --ours -- src/MhwModManager.App/ViewModels/MainWindowViewModel.cs
  $vmPath='src/MhwModManager.App/ViewModels/MainWindowViewModel.cs'
  $vm=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($vmPath)
  $vm=$vm.Replace('if(result.Isolated)await s.Issues.MarkBisectResultAsync(result.Suspects,ct:ct);','if(result.Isolated && result.Suspects.Count == 1)await s.Issues.MarkBisectResultAsync(result.Suspects,ct:ct);')
  $vm=$vm.Replace('await ApplyStateDirectAsync(currentState,"Restore setup after crash diagnosis",ct);','await ApplyStateDirectAsync(currentState,"Restore setup after crash diagnosis",CancellationToken.None);')
  $old='var delay=Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12),ct);var exit=process.WaitForExitAsync(ct);var completed=await Task.WhenAny(delay,exit);'+[Environment]::NewLine+'        if(completed==exit)return true;'+[Environment]::NewLine+'        try{process.Kill(true);await process.WaitForExitAsync(ct);}catch(InvalidOperationException){}'+[Environment]::NewLine+'        return false;'
  $new='try'+[Environment]::NewLine+'        {'+[Environment]::NewLine+'            var delay=Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12),ct);var exit=process.WaitForExitAsync(ct);'+[Environment]::NewLine+'            var completed=await Task.WhenAny(delay,exit);ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();'+[Environment]::NewLine+'            if(completed==exit){await exit;return true;}'+[Environment]::NewLine+'            return false;'+[Environment]::NewLine+'        }'+[Environment]::NewLine+'        finally'+[Environment]::NewLine+'        {'+[Environment]::NewLine+'            try{if(!process.HasExited){process.Kill(true);await process.WaitForExitAsync(CancellationToken.None);}}'+[Environment]::NewLine+'            catch(InvalidOperationException){}'+[Environment]::NewLine+'        }'
  if($vm.Contains($old)){$vm=$vm.Replace($old,$new)} elseif($vm -notmatch 'WaitForExitAsync\(CancellationToken.None\)'){throw 'CRASH_PROBE_ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND'}
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($vmPath,$vm,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  git add -- $vmPath

  git checkout --theirs -- src/MhwModManager.Automation/CrashBisectorEngine.cs
  git add -- src/MhwModManager.Automation/CrashBisectorEngine.cs

  git checkout --ours -- src/MhwModManager.Automation/SmartInboxService.cs
  $inboxPath='src/MhwModManager.Automation/SmartInboxService.cs'
  $inbox=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($inboxPath)
  if($inbox -notmatch 'FomodInstallerService.HasInstaller'){
    $anchor='                var category = categories.Classify('
    $i=$inbox.IndexOf($anchor,[StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if($i -lt 0){throw 'SMART_INBOX_ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND'}
    $block='                if (FomodInstallerService.HasInstaller(destination))'+[Environment]::NewLine+
      '                {'+[Environment]::NewLine+
      '                    Directory.Delete(destination, true);'+[Environment]::NewLine+
      '                    results.Add(new(entry, null, false, AutomationCategory.Unknown, "Installer choices required. Use Import and select this Inbox archive; source left untouched."));'+[Environment]::NewLine+
      '                    continue;'+[Environment]::NewLine+
      '                }'+[Environment]::NewLine
    $inbox=$inbox.Insert($i,$block)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($inboxPath,$inbox,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  }
  git add -- $inboxPath

  git checkout --ours -- tools/MhwModManager.SelfTest/Program.cs
  $selfPath='tools/MhwModManager.SelfTest/Program.cs'
  $self=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($selfPath)
  $oldRecipe='await Run("Recipe export",async()=>{var db=await Db("recipe.db");var path=Path.Combine(temp,"recipe.json");await new CollectionRecipeService(db).ExportAsync(path);using var doc=JsonDocument.Parse(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(path));if(doc.RootElement.GetProperty("format").GetInt32()!=1)throw new InvalidOperationException("Recipe format missing.");});'
  $newRecipe='await Run("Recipe export",async()=>{var db=await Db("recipe.db");var path=Path.Combine(temp,"recipe.json");await new CollectionRecipeService(db).ExportAsync(path);using var doc=JsonDocument.Parse(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(path));if(doc.RootElement.GetProperty("format").GetInt32()!=2)throw new InvalidOperationException("Recipe format 2 missing.");var preview=await new CollectionRecipeService(db).PreviewAsync(path);if(preview.Matches.Count!=0)throw new InvalidOperationException("Empty recipe round-trip was not empty.");});'
  if($self.Contains($oldRecipe)){$self=$self.Replace($oldRecipe,$newRecipe)} elseif($self -notmatch 'Recipe format 2'){throw 'SELFTEST_RECIPE_ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND'}
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($selfPath,$self,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  git add -- $selfPath

  $u=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)
  if($u.Count){throw ('UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTS:'+($u -join ','))}

  Write-Output '=== FEATURE DIFF ==='
  git diff --cached --name-status
  dotnet build MhwModManager.sln -c Release
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'RELEASE_BUILD_FAILED'}
  dotnet test MhwModManager.sln -c Release --no-build
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'RELEASE_TEST_FAILED'}

  git commit -m 'Integrate complete mod workflows on current main'
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'MERGE_COMMIT_FAILED'}
  $head=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  git fetch origin
  $remote=(git rev-parse origin/main).Trim()
  if($remote -ne $base){throw ('MAIN_MOVED_AFTER_TESTS:'+ $base +'->'+$remote)}
  git push -u origin $branch
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'PUSH_INTEGRATION_FAILED'}
  [pscustomobject]@{status='ready';base=$base;head=$head;legacy=(git rev-parse HEAD^2).Trim();branch=$branch} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
} finally { Pop-Location }
